title: Beyond the Prototype: Using AI to Write High-Quality Code - Josh Albrecht, Imbue
talk_summary: Imbue's CTO describes Sculptor, an experimental coding agent environment focused on preventing and detecting defects in AI-generated code rather than just generating it. He lays out four prevention techniques (research, plan-first, specs/docs, strict style guide) and three detection techniques (linters, tests, LLM review), plus cheap parallel retries for fixing.

takeaways.technique: Lint-delta gating (baseline vs post-change lint errors)
takeaways.what_they_do: The agent records which lint issues existed before it started and which exist after, so it is only held accountable for newly introduced errors, not pre-existing debt.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the AI system understands what issues were there before it started and then what issues were there after it ran

takeaways.what_they_do: For functional-style code, have the LLM generate hundreds/thousands of inputs, observe outputs, and ask the LLM whether results look weird; weird results become bug-reproducing test cases.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you can have the LLM generate hundreds or even thousands of potential inputs, see what happens to those inputs, and then ask the LLM, does that look weird?
takeaways.numbers: hundreds to thousands of generated inputs

takeaways.technique: Test coverage as a merge signal
takeaways.what_they_do: Treat coverage and test-pass plus an LLM judgment of test reasonableness as part of the merge decision, not just line counts.
takeaways.evidence_quote: there's 100% test coverage and also all the tests pass and also a thing looked at the tests and thought they were reasonable

takeaways.what_they_do: Once a problem is well-specified, run many agents in parallel with different attempts; take the first success. Enabled by strong sandboxing.
Force the agent to produce a plan with no code by swapping the system prompt, then switch to a coding phase; build reusable plan-then-code-then-check agent workflows.
takeaways.evidence_quote: change the system prompt again to say like, okay, now we can actually create some code

takeaways.what_they_do: Automatically detect when code and docs/specs are inconsistent or specs conflict, lowering the cost of keeping specs current so agents have project context.
takeaways.evidence_quote: helping detect if the code and the docs have become outdated
